sources: Kephart (1967), Some correlates of romantic love, Journal of Marriage and the Family 29(3), 470–474 – US college students: 'If a boy (girl) had all the other qualities you desired, would you marry this person if you were not in love with him/her?' – No: 65 % of men, 24 % of women (rest yes or undecided); cited e.g. in Peplau & Gordon (1985).

Levine, Sato, Hashimoto & Verma (1995), Love and marriage in eleven cultures, Journal of Cross-Cultural Psychology 26(5), 554–571 – same question: only 3.5 % of US respondents said yes; only respondents from India and Pakistan were broadly fine with marrying without love. Dots schematic (100 = women 1967).
